purpose: Source-verified evidence candidates for M2 review; not production knowledge and not an agronomic recommendation.

verified_evidence.claim: BARC's handbook states that potato is grown in Bangladesh in the Rabi season; it defines Rabi as mid-October to mid-March.
verified_evidence.context: General Bangladesh season context stated in the handbook introduction.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh-wide general context; not a Comilla recommendation.
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Introduction, printed pp. 1-2; PDF pp. 15-16 (0-based page index).
limitations: The handbook is dated 2013; continued validity has not been independently verified.
Rabi season context is not a crop-specific sowing date or a locality-specific recommendation.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: After review, use only as broad season context. Do not derive planting or harvest dates from this fact.

verified_evidence.claim: The handbook states that medium-high to high land with loamy to sandy-loam soil is best suitable for potato cultivation.
verified_evidence.context: General production-technology statement; the source does not identify a district or variety for this passage.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh handbook context; locality-specific applicability is not established.
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Section II, Tuber Crops, Potato, 1.2 Production Technology, Land and soil; printed p. 38; PDF p. 52 (0-based page index).
limitations: The statement requires both land-type and soil-texture context; the Golden Farm example supplies only demo soil text and no verified land type.
The handbook is dated 2013, and currentness/locality have not been independently verified.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Candidate context only after review; do not infer that the Golden Farm field is suitable from the demo value 'loamy'.

verified_evidence.claim: The handbook describes winter-season cultivation in most parts of Bangladesh, says sunny weather with sufficient soil moisture is appropriate, and reports an optimum growth and development temperature range of 15-21 degrees C.
verified_evidence.context: General statements in the potato introduction; not a farm-level climate assessment.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh-wide broad context, qualified by the source as 'most parts'; no districts or upazilas are specified.
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Section II, Tuber Crops, Potato, opening paragraph; printed p. 35; PDF p. 49 (0-based page index).
limitations: The source does not establish Comilla-specific climate suitability or define the temperature measurement period.
The handbook is dated 2013; currentness has not been independently verified.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: After review, treat as general source context only; do not compare it to NASA/weather observations or infer farm suitability in this phase.

verified_evidence.claim: The handbook states that 15-30 November is the optimum sowing time and that sowing may be done from October to December.
verified_evidence.context: General potato production-technology passage; no named variety or district is attached to the statement.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh handbook context; locality-specific applicability is not established.
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Section II, Tuber Crops, Potato, 1.2 Production Technology, Time of sowing; printed p. 38; PDF p. 52 (0-based page index).
limitations: The handbook does not give a Comilla-specific window or a variety-specific window at this location.
The handbook is dated 2013; currentness has not been independently verified.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Candidate only; require current locality and variety review before using for a season plan.

verified_evidence.claim: The handbook states that irrigation need depends on soil type, pre-sowing irrigation may sometimes be required, and irrigation could normally be applied at 8-10, 40-45, and 60-65 days after sowing, with water maintained to two-thirds of furrow depth.
verified_evidence.context: General production-technology passage; stated as conditional on soil type and without a named variety or district.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh handbook context; locality-specific applicability is not established.
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Section II, Tuber Crops, Potato, 1.2 Production Technology, Irrigation; printed p. 39; PDF p. 53 (0-based page index).
limitations: The passage is conditional and does not provide a water volume.
It does not establish a schedule for Comilla or for an identified variety.
The handbook is dated 2013; currentness has not been independently verified.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Candidate only; never turn this into an automatic schedule without reviewing soil, variety, locality, and current source validity.

verified_evidence.claim: The handbook states that harvesting should be done 80-90 days after sowing, depending on variety.
verified_evidence.context: General harvesting and seed-preservation section; interval explicitly varies by variety.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh handbook context; locality-specific applicability is not established.
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Section II, Tuber Crops, Potato, 1.4 Harvesting and Seed preservation; printed p. 45; PDF p. 59 (0-based page index).
limitations: No variety is specified in the statement, and the source explicitly says the interval depends on variety.
No observable maturity indicator is provided by this sentence.
The handbook is dated 2013; currentness has not been independently verified.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Candidate interval only after variety-specific review; do not issue as a fixed harvest date or maturity indicator.

verified_evidence.claim: BARC defines its crop-suitability classes by percentages of maximum attainable yield: very suitable above 80%, suitable 60-80%, moderately suitable 40-60%, marginally suitable 20-40%, and not suitable below 20%. Its crop-zoning maps summarize the percentage of an upazila's cultivable area falling in each crop-suitability class.
verified_evidence.context: Interpretation rules for BARC's crop-suitability and crop-zoning maps, including its potato map.
verified_evidence.geographic_scope: Bangladesh; map aggregation uses upazila cultivable-area coverage.
verified_evidence.source_title: Land Suitability Assessment and Crop Zoning of Bangladesh — Introduction and methodology
verified_evidence.evidence_location: Crop Suitability and Crop Zoning sections; the page attributes the underlying book to S. G. Hussain, M. K. A. Chowdhury, and M. A. H. Chowdhury but shows no publication date.
limitations: These class definitions do not identify Comilla's potato class; that result was not verified.
The map's upazila coverage must not be interpreted as suitability of every field or a particular 2-acre farm.
The online page does not provide a date/version for the displayed map data.
verified_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Use only to interpret a verified locality-level map result; never infer a field-level suitability class from an upazila aggregate.

rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.claim_investigated: A BARC potato suitability class for Comilla district or a Comilla upazila.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.source_title: Land Suitability Assessment and Crop Zoning of Bangladesh; Suitability Map of Potato; Crop Zone Maps and Data
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.evidence_location: BARC methodology page states that crop-zoning maps use the share of an upazila's cultivable area under each crop-suitability class; the public potato map shown is Bangladesh-wide. The current CZIS page requires an upazila code or location selection, but a Comilla result was not retrievable/verified in this research.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.limitations: No Comilla district/upazila class was verified. National area totals and general methodology cannot be converted into a Comilla class or an individual 2-acre field recommendation.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Do not use for Comilla recommendations until BARC's matching local result and dataset version are verified.

rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.claim_investigated: The Golden Farm's two-acre loamy field is suitable for potato.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.source_organization: Project demo scenario, not an agricultural source
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.evidence_location: Golden Farm sample values are explicitly examples in plan.md.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.limitations: Demo values are not agricultural evidence. The BARC handbook soil statement also requires medium-high to high land, which is not specified by the demo.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Reject as an agronomic claim; never use demo values as verified suitability evidence.

rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.claim_investigated: A complete Potato growth-stage sequence with local stage durations.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.evidence_location: Potato production-technology and intercultural-operation sections, printed pp. 38-39.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.limitations: The reviewed passages include operation timings after sowing, not a complete biological growth-stage definition set suitable for the M2 growth-stage contract.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Do not convert operation timings into growth-stage definitions. Seek a specific reviewed source for stages.

rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.claim_investigated: A disease-based early harvest window as general harvest guidance.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.evidence_location: Late-blight control subsection, printed p. 40; PDF p. 54 (0-based page index).
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.limitations: The early planting/harvest date appears within disease-control guidance. Disease belongs to M6, and this context does not support general M2 harvest guidance.
rejected_or_insufficient_evidence.recommended_m2_use: Exclude from M2 evidence; do not extract disease-management advice into harvest guidance.

comilla_coverage.explanation: The BARC methodology supports upazila-scale zoning in principle, but the Comilla district/upazila potato class and versioned underlying data were not verified. The 2013 handbook provides general Bangladesh-context candidates, not a Comilla-specific suitability result.

not_production_ready: Every item above is a research candidate. No record is approved, ingested, or eligible for a real recommendation without currentness and context review.
